name: stingray
description: Stop hook that catches a turn stopping half-done and pushes Codex back to finish it.

interface.shortDescription: Keep Codex working when a turn stops half-done.
interface.longDescription: Stingray checks Codex Stop events for unfinished actions and unfulfilled promises, then asks Codex to continue.
